{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for customers who converted
target_group = sales_df[sales_df['converted'] == 1]

# Identify invalid ages (negative values)
invalid_ages = target_group[target_group['customer_age'] < 0]

# Drop invalid age records before computing mean
valid_target_group = target_group[target_group['customer_age'] >= 0]

# Compute mean age of valid converted customers
mean_age_converted = valid_target_group['customer_age'].mean()

# Check the number of invalid records
num_invalid = len(invalid_ages)

mean_age_converted, num_invalid"}
